headline: Wind Element Matchups
title: Aniimo Wind Element Explained | What Wind Beats and Fears | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Wind attacks deal super effective damage to Grass and Dark. Against Lightning and other Wind Aniimo, Wind attacks are resisted. In return, Lightning and Light hit Wind hard, so keep your Wind Aniimo away from them. A super effective hit does one point six times damage. Wind is great against Dark and Grass teams. Which Wind Aniimo is your favorite? Comment below!
description: Aniimo Wind element matchups: Wind is strong against Grass and Dark, resisted by Lightning and Wind, and takes extra damage from Lightning and Light.
